# pmon_role (Data Source)

One access-control role, by name.

Use it to refer to a shipped `system:` role, which cannot be managed as a resource, without hard-coding the string in several places.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Shipped system: roles cannot be managed as resources, so refer to one rather than repeating
# the string wherever a policy or a group binding needs it.
data "pmon_role" "production_viewer" {
  name = "system:production-viewer"
}

resource "pmon_group_roles" "analysts" {
  group_name = pmon_group.analysts.name
  role_names = [data.pmon_role.production_viewer.name]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Role name.

### Read-Only

- `description` (String) What holding the role means.
- `id` (Number) pmon's internal id.
- `is_system` (Boolean) Whether this is a shipped role, which pmon will not let you modify.
